summary.text: Karen Keys-Gamarra is a Democratic member of the Virginia House of Delegates representing District 7, which covers part of Fairfax County.
Karen Keys-Gamarra has been a member since January 10, 2024.

paragraphs.text: According to the House profile, Karen Keys-Gamarra was born in St. Louis, Missouri.
Karen Keys-Gamarra studied at Washington University School of Law (J.D., 1987) and Tulane University (B.A., 1982).
Karen Keys-Gamarra's listed occupation is attorney.

Karen Keys-Gamarra's listed memberships and affiliations include the Fairfax County Sully District Planning Commission (2016-17), the George Mason University Carter School of Political Leadership advisory council board (since February 2022), the Virginia Women Attorneys Association (since 2022), the Educate Fairfax board (August 2021 to July 2023), Emerge (class of 2016), and the Fairfax Bar Association (since 2023).
The profile lists Antoine Andre Gamarra as Karen Keys-Gamarra's spouse.
The House profile lists Karen Keys-Gamarra's committee assignments as Finance, Counties, Cities and Towns, Communications, Technology and Innovation, and Courts of Justice.
